plan.notes: Source: ATC Academic MAP 'Associate in Arts (AA)', effective Summer 2026 (official atc.edu PDF). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. The map publishes a 60-62 credit range (the COL orientation slot is 1-3 cr); total_credits=60 reflects the minimum path (COL 101/COL 106 at 1 cr). All transfer-track slots are advisor/transfer-objective choice slots; no courses, credits, or prereqs invented.
